title: Billing Entitlements Continuation
request: Continue the existing billing store from the prior phase. Add entitlement-aware billing without replacing the in-memory API: plans may define feature entitlements and usage limits, subscriptions should expose feature access, usage can be recorded per customer and metric, over-limit subscriptions must be detectable, and summarizeBilling must surface entitlement and over-limit status.
context: Phase 1 already delivered plan creation, customer subscription assignment, subscription listing, and a basic billing summary. The prior handoff is in docs/phase-1-billing.md.
Feature entitlements are string feature keys on plans. Usage limits are numeric per-metric monthly limits on plans.
canUseFeature(customerId, feature) should return true only when the customer has an active subscription to a plan that includes the feature.
Over-limit detection should compare recorded usage to the subscribed plan's usageLimits. Unknown customers, plans, features, or metrics should use structured validation errors where appropriate.
Do not add persistence, payment provider calls, invoices, or dependencies. Keep the injectable now() clock and existing public API behavior.
successCriteria: Existing billing tests continue to pass.
createPlan accepts optional features and usageLimits while preserving existing plan fields.
canUseFeature evaluates feature access for subscribed customers.
recordUsage and listOverLimitSubscriptions track usage against plan limits deterministically.
summarizeBilling adds enabledFeatureCount, overLimitCount, billingStatus, and nextAction.
